corrected_code:
class TasksController < ApplicationController
  def create
    project = current_user.accessible_projects.find(task_params[:project_id])
    @task = project.tasks.build(task_params.except(:project_id))
    @task.creator = current_user
    @task.save!
    render json: @task, status: :created
  end

  private

  def task_params
    params.require(:task).permit(:title, :description, :project_id, :assignee_id)
  end
end
